title: adsb.lol: a key for planes every 1 to 2 minutes (a free adhoc key by request form, or a feeder key)
summary: Dinis: adsb.lol's keyless limit is 500 requests a day per IP, so incident.flights@ reads Lisbon every 5 minutes and Madeira every 20 (e9c24a6). Planes every 1 to 2 minutes need a key, your call: a free adhoc key by request form (1,000 a day: Lisbon every 2 minutes and Madeira every 10) or a feeder key (7,200 a day; needs a receiver feeding adsb.lol). Source: api.adsb.lol/docs, read by incident.flights@ at 23:40 UTC.
closes: Dinis answers (in BRIEF.md or through the conductor), and incident.flights@ no longer lists it.
